description: Use this when the user wants the current odds or the details of one specific prediction market or event — for example "what are the odds for the Fed decision in October", "who leads the race for the 2028 Democratic nomination", "show me this market: polymarket.com/event/…", "what are the rules for this market", or "did the 2024 election market resolve, and to what". Accepts a market or event slug, a supported market or event link, a condition id, or the market's question in words. Returns each outcome's market-implied probability from Polymarket.com with its 24-hour change (up to 40 outcomes, mutually exclusive ones ranked, plus the total count), volume, liquidity, end date, status, the resolution rules and source, and the final result for resolved markets. Works for open, closed and resolved markets; when nothing matches it returns up to 3 of the closest open markets instead. Read-only: it cannot place trades, and probabilities are crowd forecasts, not advice. Do not call this when the user asks which market to buy or how to make a profit.

market.description: The market or event: a slug such as 'fed-decision-in-october-20260617190323537', a supported market or event link, a condition id (0x + 64 hex), or the question in words

name: get_market_odds

outcomes.description: Ranked by probability for mutually exclusive outcomes; natural order for ladders

market_slug.description: Slug of the market that prices this outcome

outcomes_total.description: Total outcomes in the event; outcomes[] may be truncated

type.description: binary = one Yes/No (or two-sided) market; multi = several mutually exclusive or laddered outcomes

focus.description: The specific market asked about (null when an event was asked about as a whole)

suggestions.description: Closest open markets when the request matched nothing

title: Get market odds
